name: XDG Utils with host browser pipe
description: Installs xdg-utils and wraps xdg-open to forward URLs to the host browser through a unix pipe. Binds the host browser pipe into the container at /tmp/hostbrowserpipe; when the pipe is absent, xdg-open falls back to the real /usr/bin/xdg-open. The pipe path is a host bind mount, so a host that uses a non-default location must override this feature's mount in devcontainer.json.

hostBrowserPipePath.description: Path of the host browser pipe this feature declares as a bind mount (sourced to /tmp/hostbrowserpipe). Override the mount in devcontainer.json if your host uses a non-default location.

containerBrowserPipePath.description: Path inside the container where the host browser pipe is bound. The bind mount source follows the default; a non-default host path must override the mount in devcontainer.json.
